delta_score_definition: delta = vina_on_target - vina_off_target; more negative = more selective

off_target_protocol.box_center: off-target crystal reference ligand, mass-weighted centre
off_target_protocol.ligand_placement: rigid translation of the generated ligand centre of mass onto off_ref_center
off_target_protocol.note: on-target numbers are REUSED from each model .pt and were measured with the own-bbox box (buffer 5) at exhaustiveness 16 -- the asymmetry is deliberate, see analysis/METHODS_delta_score.md
